claims.author: Crypt-iQ
claims.harm: In process_message(s), static testing_setup is destructed before static g_filter_indexes, causing BaseIndex::Stop to access already-destructed testing_setup.m_node
claims.quote: I think CI failures are because in process_message(s) the `static testing_setup` is destructed before `static g_filter_indexes` so `BaseIndex::Stop` will try to access `testing_setup.m_node`.

status_by.quote: Thx, fixed by destroying the indexes in the testing dtor, which seems useful generally, unrelated to the changes here.

claims.status_note: author replied that it was fixed by destroying indexes in testing destructor
